trial_type.Description: Categorical label indicating the condition or type of trial.

Levels.Subsequent_Hit: Stimulus subsequently called 'old' in the recognition memory test
Levels.Subsequent_Miss: Stimulus subsequently called 'new' in the recognition memory test
Levels.Subsequent_NoResp: Stumulus with no button press at either study OR test

face.Description: Path and filename of face stimulus

response.Description: The button or key pressed by the participant in response to the stimulus.
